title: Unveiling the Secret of AdaLN-Zero in Diffusion Transformer
abstract: Diffusion transformer (DiT), a rapidly emerging architecture for image generation, has gained much attention. However, despite ongoing efforts to improve its performance, the understanding of DiT remains superficial. In this work, we delve into and investigate a critical conditioning mechanism within DiT, adaLN-Zero, which achieves superior performance compared to adaLN. Our work studies three potential elements driving this performance, including an SE-like structure, zero-initialization, and a "gradual" update order, among which zero-initialization is proved to be the most influential. Building on this understanding, we propose an analysis-guided initialization strategy, termed adaLN-Gaussian, which serves both as an empirical validation of our analysis and as a practical initialization method that consistently improves optimization efficiency. On the other hand, inspired by the SE-like structure, we introduce an improved conditioning mechanism called SE-adaLN-Zero. Extensive experiments following DiT on four datasets, especially on ImageNet1K demonstrate the effectiveness and generalization of adaLN-Gaussian and SE-adaLN-Zero. Beyond class-to-image generation, we also evaluate the generalization of the two improved methods on text-to-image generation.

analysis.sourceNote: 依据 arXiv 2608.09438v1 exact-version PDF 全文、文本抽取与页面渲染核验；代码状态按该版本 PDF 记录为 not-found，未发布 Code link。
analysis.ideaZh: 这篇机制研究把 DiT 中 adaLN-Zero 的优势拆成 zero initialization 与逐步更新：零初始化 modulation 令 residual block 初始近似 identity，并形成有利的优化轨迹。作者以 adaLN-Gaussian 等对照验证 initialization 是主要因素，再提出 SE-adaLN-Zero 以更受控的 conditioning 更新改善收敛，并跨数据集/模型规模报告增益。
analysis.whyRelevantZh: adaLN-Zero 是 DiT/flow transformer 的关键 conditioning primitive；理解其优化机制可直接指导 image/video generation backbone 设计。
analysis.evidenceZh: 论文将 adaLN-Zero 分解为 zero initialization、update dynamics 与 gating effects。（Motivation and mechanism overview, pp. 1–2）；adaLN-Gaussian 对照显示随机初始化会损害早期训练。（Mechanism experiments, Sec. 4, pp. 6–8）；SE-adaLN-Zero 以受控 conditioning modulation 改善训练。（SE-adaLN-Zero, Sec. 5, pp. 9–10）；作者报告 proposed variant 在多个 DiT scales/datasets 优于标准 conditioning variants。（Main results, Tables 3–5, pp. 10–12）
analysis.caveatZh: 审阅风险：从小中型 DiT 实验推到大规模 multimodal diffusion/flow models 仍需验证。；审阅风险：优化轨迹证据支持相关机制，但不能完全排除不同 parameterization 带来的隐含 capacity 差异。
analysis.motivationZh: 论文从 adaptive LayerNorm modulation 的初始化、更新幅度与 residual gating 分析 adaLN-Zero。通过将 zero init 替换为 Gaussian、交换 update mechanism，并跟踪 parameter norms/gradients，作者主张逐渐注入 condition 比随机强扰动更稳定；SE variant 进一步重参数化 modulation，使 conditioning evolution 更平滑。
analysis.methodZh: 论文从 adaptive LayerNorm modulation 的初始化、更新幅度与 residual gating 分析 adaLN-Zero。通过将 zero init 替换为 Gaussian、交换 update mechanism，并跟踪 parameter norms/gradients，作者主张逐渐注入 condition 比随机强扰动更稳定；SE variant 进一步重参数化 modulation，使 conditioning evolution 更平滑。 价值在于给常用但经验性的 adaLN-Zero 提供可检验机制分解，并用构造性 variant 将分析转化为优化设计，而非仅报告更大模型结果。
analysis.experimentsZh: 在多种 image datasets 和 DiT scales 上比较 adaLN-Zero、adaLN-Gaussian、standard adaLN 与 SE variant，跟踪 FID/训练损失、modulation norms、gradient/update dynamics，并做初始化和模块拆分。 作者报告：作者报告 zero-initialized modulation 相比 Gaussian/standard initialization 具有更稳定且更快的 early optimization。（Secs. 4.1–4.3, pp. 6–9）；作者报告 SE-adaLN-Zero 在多种训练配置中进一步改善 convergence 或 FID。（Tables 3–5, pp. 10–12） Baseline boundary：对初始化与 conditioning variants 的覆盖充分，并跨规模/数据集；未覆盖现代大型 text-to-image/video backbones 的完整训练栈。 Ablation boundary：核心就是 factorized ablation：zero/Gaussian init、gating、update trajectory 与 SE design，因果归因相对清楚。
analysis.insightZh: 价值在于给常用但经验性的 adaLN-Zero 提供可检验机制分解，并用构造性 variant 将分析转化为优化设计，而非仅报告更大模型结果。 机制问题基础且对生成模型架构有广泛影响，controlled ablations 值得精读；不要把局部实验外推为所有 DiT 的定论。
